description_tr: Mina ve Efe, gün boyunca 'lütfen' ve 'teşekkür ederim' demenin güzelliğini keşfediyor. Nezaket dolu bu tatlı macera, çocuklara sihirli sözcüklerin önemini öğretiyor.
description_en: Mina and Efe discover the joy of saying 'please' and 'thank you' throughout their day. This sweet adventure teaches children the value of polite words.

lines.text: Güneşli ve neşeli bir sabah başlıyor.
lines.en: A sunny and cheerful morning begins.

lines.text: Günaydın Efe! Bugün harika bir gün olacak.
lines.en: Good morning, Efe! Today will be a wonderful day.

lines.text: Günaydın Mina abla! Hadi hemen oyun oynayalım.
lines.en: Good morning, big sister Mina! Let's play right now.

lines.text: Önce odamızı toplayalım, sonra boyama yaparız.
lines.en: First let's tidy our room, then we can color.
Give me my red crayon!

lines.text: Efe, bir şey isterken ne diyorduk?
lines.en: Efe, what do we say when we ask for something?
I can't remember, what did we say, sister?

lines.text: Sihirli bir sözcük vardı hani: Lütfen!
lines.en: There was a magic word, remember: Please!
Could you give me the red crayon, please?

lines.text: İşte boya kalemin burada, al bakalım!
lines.en: Here is your crayon, here you go!
Thank you so much, sister!
You are welcome, sweet brother.
Magic words bring an instant smile to faces.
I think my tummy is getting a bit hungry!
There are apples and milk on the table.
Give me milk!
Efe, what did we just learn?
I remembered! Could you pass the milk, please?
Of course, enjoy it, Efe.
Thank you, big sister Mina!
Saying please warms everyone's heart.
Would you like a red apple too?

lines.text: Evet, bir dilim verir misin lütfen?
lines.en: Yes, could you give me a slice, please?
Well done, here is your sweet apple!
Thank you very much!

lines.text: Her zaman rica ederim canım kardeşim.
lines.en: You are always welcome, my dear brother.
Saying magic words is so much fun.
Shall we water the flowers in the garden now?
Yes, I love watering the flowers!
Let's take the yellow watering can from the counter.

lines.text: Ben yetişemiyorum, bana verir misin lütfen?
lines.en: I can't reach, could you give it to me, please?
Of course I will, here you go.
Thanks, dear sister!

lines.text: Efe sihirli sözcükleri çok çabuk öğrendi.
lines.en: Efe learned the magic words very quickly.
Let's go outside to the garden!

lines.text: Bak, sarı papatyalar ne kadar güzel!
lines.en: Look, how beautiful the yellow daisies are!
Let's give them lots of water.
The flowers feel refreshed with cool water.

lines.text: Mina abla, hortumu bana tutar mısın lütfen?
lines.en: Sister Mina, could you hold the hose for me, please?
Gladly, Efe.

lines.text: Çiçekler de bize teşekkür ediyor gibi!
lines.en: It looks like the flowers are thanking us too!
Yes, they smile by swaying their leaves.
I want to run in the garden!
Be careful, the grass is a bit wet.

lines.text: Abla, şapkam düştü, alır mısın lütfen?
lines.en: Sister, my hat fell, could you pick it up, please?
I'll get it right away, here's your hat!
Thank you very much, dear sister.

lines.text: Rica ederim, nezaketin beni çok mutlu etti.
lines.en: You're welcome, your kindness made me so happy.
Polite words bring siblings closer together.

lines.text: Hasan Dede bugün parkta laleleri suluyor.
lines.en: Grandpa Hasan is watering tulips in the park today.
Shall we help him too?
Wonderful idea, he would be delighted!
Could you open the park gate, please?
Opening it, let's hold hands and walk.
Thank you, don't let go of my hand.

lines.text: Çocuklar el ele parka doğru yürüyor.
lines.en: Hand in hand, the children walk toward the park.
Hello, Grandpa Hasan!
May it be easy, Grandpa Hasan!
Welcome, my lovely children, how are you?

lines.text: Çok iyiyiz, sana yardım etmek istedik.
lines.en: We're great, we wanted to help you.

lines.text: Ne kadar düşüncelisiniz, çok teşekkür ederim.
lines.en: How thoughtful you are, thank you very much.
You're welcome, dear grandpa!
Grandpa Hasan smiled at the children's cheerfulness.
Could you fill the bucket from the fountain, please?
We'll fill it right away, Grandpa Hasan!
I can turn on the tap too!
Here, the bucket is full of water.
Thank you for your trouble, well done, my children.
It's nothing, dear grandpa!

lines.text: Birlikte çalışmak işleri ne kadar kolaylaştırıyor.
lines.en: Working together makes tasks so much easier.

lines.text: Lütfen ve teşekkür kelimeleri anahtar gibidir.
lines.en: Please and thank you are just like keys.
Keys to what, Grandpa Hasan?
They are keys to hearts and doors of friendship.

lines.text: Doğru, bu sözleri duyunca herkes mutlu oluyor.
lines.en: True, everyone feels happy hearing these words.

lines.text: Ben o sihirli anahtarları çok sevdim!
lines.en: I really love those magic keys!
Now you can play in the park, children.
Thank you Grandpa Hasan, see you soon!
I want to ride the swing!
You should say, could you swing me please.
Could you swing me a little, please?
Of course I will swing you, hold on tight!
I'm flying like the wind, thanks sister!
The swing rises cheerfully toward the sky.
Is it my turn now, I wonder?

lines.text: Evet abla, şimdi sen bin salıncağa.
lines.en: Yes sister, now you get on the swing.

lines.text: Sıranı paylaştığın için çok teşekkür ederim.
lines.en: Thank you so much for sharing your turn.

lines.text: Rica ederim, ben de seni iterim!
lines.en: You're welcome, I'll push you too!
Push gently please, Efe.
Okay, pushing slowly.

lines.text: Sırayla oynamak ve nezaket göstermek harikadır.
lines.en: Taking turns and showing kindness is wonderful.
Shall we go to the slide too?
I'll wait for my turn when using the slide.
Would you like to slide first?
Yes, could you permit me, please?
Of course you can slide, the way is yours!

lines.text: Huuu! Çok eğlenceliydi, teşekkür ederim abla!
lines.en: Wheee! That was so fun, thank you sister!
You're welcome, sweet brother.

lines.text: Nezaketle oynanan oyunlar her zaman daha güzeldir.
lines.en: Games played with kindness are always better.
Are you tired now, little rascals?
A little bit tired, but we had so much fun.
May we sit in the tree's shade, please?
Of course, come sit next to me.

lines.text: Bize masal anlatır mısın Hasan Dede?
lines.en: Will you tell us a story, Grandpa Hasan?
Did you forget to say please, Efe?

lines.text: Pardon! Masal anlatır mısın lütfen dedeciğim?
lines.en: Sorry! Would you tell a story, please, dear grandpa?

lines.text: Böyle güzel rica edene masal anlatılmaz mı hiç!
lines.en: How could I not tell a story to someone asking so nicely!

lines.text: Çok teşekkürler dede, seni çok seviyoruz.
lines.en: Thanks so much, grandpa, we love you so much.

lines.text: Lütfen demek işleri ne kadar kolaylaştırıyor.
lines.en: Saying please makes things so much easier.

lines.text: Gülümsemek ve teşekkür etmek sevgi köprüsüdür.
lines.en: Smiling and thanking build bridges of love.

lines.text: Ben her gün bu kelimeleri söyleyeceğim.
lines.en: I will say these words every day.

lines.text: Ben de seninle gurur duyuyorum Efe.
lines.en: I'm so proud of you too, Efe.

lines.text: Yaşlı çınarın altında neşeli sohbet devam etti.
lines.en: The cheerful chat continued under the old plane tree.

lines.text: Eve döndük ve harika şeyler öğrendik.
lines.en: We came back home and learned wonderful things.

lines.text: Lütfen demek ve teşekkür etmek çok kolay!
lines.en: Saying please and thank you is so easy!

lines.text: Siz de evde sihirli sözcükleri kullanıyor musunuz?
lines.en: Do you also use magic words at home?

lines.text: Bir şey isterken lütfen demeyi unutmayın!
lines.en: Don't forget to say please when asking for something!

lines.text: Bizi dinlediğiniz için çok teşekkür ederiz.
lines.en: Thank you so much for listening to us.
Goodbye, friends!
Goodbye friends, stay with love!
